label: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily
terms_note: Anonymous search of published notices; EU Login + API key only for publishing; reuse under EU open-data terms.

auth: 2. EU Login → Manage API Keys → one key per EU Login in production (only for unpublished / publishing endpoints).

endpoints.notes: expert query, fields[], page, limit; totalNoticeCount (audit: 1035 vs 250-row page — paginate)

reference.limits: - EU open data reuse; no rate limit on the page read. - No submission API — tenders are lodged on the buyer's platform.

adapter.rate_note: Search API: 'primarily targeted at data reusers and does not require authentication' (docs.ted.europa.eu/api/latest/search.html); no rate limit published in api-v3.yaml. Limits in PAGE_NUMBER mode: 250 notices per page, 15,000 retrievable notices per query, 10,000 fields per page (fields × limit). Two requests per second.

search_postings.note: `query` is sent verbatim as the TED EXPERT query (PublicExpertSearchRequestV1.query: 'Expert search query to filter and sort notices'); plain words are refused with QUERY_SYNTAX_ERROR ('expecting {NOT, IN, '!=', '=', '~', '!~', COMPARISON_OPERATOR}'). Use the full-text field documented in api-v3.yaml: FT~"<words>" (e.g. FT~"cloud hosting"), or a field search such as notice-title~"software", combinable with AND/OR, e.g. (FT~"software") AND (classification-cpv=72000000). `category` and `min_budget` are not sent. scope=ACTIVE restricts to active notices; page/limit paginate (limit ≤ 250). The fixed `fields` list is what the vocabulary needs; `title` is notice-title.eng and `buyer` buyer-name.eng[0] (i18n maps keyed by ISO 639-2 language — null when the notice has no English text; other languages stay in `raw`), `url` links.html.ENG, `deadline` the first deadline-receipt-tender-date-lot (null on older notices). Total = totalNoticeCount.

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify (the Search API needs no key) and no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: api-v3.yaml documents no GET by publication number: GET /v3/notices lists the caller's OWN submitted notices (API key), so the reference page's 'GET /v3/notices/{publication-number}' is UNCONFIRMED. Re-read a notice from the search hit (`url`/raw.links) or search with query publication-number=<id>.
not_offered.submit_bid: Page: 'No submission API — tenders are lodged on the buyer's platform'; the only writes (/v3/notices/submit) publish notices for buyers with an EU Login API key.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the public API is notice search, render, convert and validate.
not_offered.send_message: No messaging API; the public API is notice search, render, convert and validate.
not_offered.credits: No account or credit endpoint; the Search API is keyless.
